name: page-toc
description: Floating 'On this page' panel for long articles: a pill at the left edge that opens a card listing the page's sections, the section in view highlighted, with a reading-progress bar; closes from its X. Shown from 1200px up (the margin beside the article column). Figma: Website Design 2026 > Floating TOC Panel (7224:2).

title.description: Panel heading and the pill's label.

items.description: Sections in page order. Each: label (required) and anchor (the id of the heading it jumps to, without #).

open.description: Start with the panel open instead of the pill.
